name: Llane Wrynn I
summary: Stormwind's defense falters as the First War turns against King Llane Wrynn I and his kingdom. Beloved and proud, Llane cannot accept that his friend Medivh has betrayed humanity, and that refusal dooms the capital.

sections.title: A Prince of Reckless Valor
sections.body: Born to King Barathen Wrynn, Prince Llane grew up with Anduin Lothar and Medivh. As youths, the three friends ventured into Stranglethorn Vale's jungles and clashed with the Gurubashi trolls. In time, Llane took the throne as Stormwind's king.

sections.title: The First War
sections.body:
When green-skinned strangers came from the southern swamps, King Llane sent Lothar to investigate the Black Morass. Minor skirmishes became the First War as the Horde overran the forests of Duskwood, Westfall, and Redridge. Messengers seeking aid from Lordaeron and the northern human kingdoms were turned away. Stormwind's long isolation and aristocratic intrigue weakened their pleas.

Even so, Llane and Lothar led a daring counterattack. They broke the Horde's first siege of Stormwind and dealt the invaders their first major defeat.

sections.title: Betrayal in the Keep
sections.body:
King Llane's steadfastness left him blind to danger in his own circle. Medivh's apprentice Khadgar and the emissary Garona told Llane that the Guardian had opened the Dark Portal. He refused to believe his childhood friend had betrayed him.

Soon after, Orgrim Doomhammer united the Horde and breached Stormwind's outer defenses. Llane directed the defense from Stormwind Keep. Under the Shadow Council's magical influence, Garona murdered the King in his throne room, carved out his heart, and sealed the city's doom.

faq.q: Who was King Llane Wrynn I?
faq.answer: King Llane Wrynn I ruled the Kingdom of Stormwind during the First War. He was the father of King Varian Wrynn and grandfather of young Prince Anduin Llane Wrynn. He died defending his people during Stormwind's first fall.

Llane was assassinated in Stormwind Keep during the First War's final siege. Garona Halforcen, a half-orc emissary he trusted as a friend and confidante, killed him under the Shadow Council's mind control.

faq.q: What was Llane's relationship to Medivh and Lothar?
faq.answer: Llane, Medivh, and Anduin Lothar were childhood companions who adventured across southern Azeroth. Lothar became Llane's greatest champion. Llane's refusal to believe Medivh could betray him led to his downfall.

faq.q: Why didn't the other human kingdoms help Llane during the First War?
faq.answer: Stormwind had long followed an isolationist foreign policy that northern nations saw as arrogant. When Llane warned of the green-skinned invaders, Lordaeron's leaders dismissed the reports as an exaggerated civil rebellion. Stormwind was left to fight alone.

faq.q: How did Varian escape the fall of Stormwind?
aliases: what happened to varian after llane died
faq.answer: After King Llane's murder and Stormwind Keep's fall, Champion Anduin Lothar gathered the surviving citizens and Llane's young son, Prince Varian Wrynn. Lothar led them to the harbor, then fled north across the Great Sea to Lordaeron.

faq.q: What did Medivh give Llane at his ascension?
faq.answer: When Llane came of age as Prince of Stormwind, Medivh emerged from a long coma and gave him an enchanted obsidian hourglass. Its sand trickled endlessly, and its upper chamber never emptied, symbolizing Stormwind's eternal prosperity.

angles.text: King Llane's murder and Stormwind's fall drove the survivors north. This directly prompted the creation of the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron to oppose the Horde.
For Stormwind's people, King Llane remains a tragic hero. His sacrifice is honored across the restored city, including in the name of King Varian's son, Anduin Llane Wrynn.
King Llane fought beside his Champion, Anduin Lothar, and directed Stormwind's martial defense from the front lines of the Keep.
Garona's assassination of King Llane remains one of Azeroth's most famous and devastating blade strikes.
